newsitem.title: CANADA: Wal-Mart to appeal pro-union ruling.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart to appeal pro-union ruling.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc plans to appeal this week's Ontario Labour Relations Board ruling that would see its first store unionized.
"We respect the law and we respect the process but we will vigorously appeal the decision which we feel does not reflect what our people voted for," Wal-Mart Canada spokesman Ed Gould said.
The labour board ruled the United Steelworkers could represent Wal-Mart's employees at a store in Windsor, Ontario, which neighbours Detroit.
Employees at the store voted 151 to 43 last May against unionizing.
The United Steelworkers complained to the labour board that Wal-Mart led employees to believe the store would be closed if a union were introduced. Wal-Mart is one of the world's largest retailers.
